tracks.name: DevOps Engineering

modules.title: Linux & the command line
modules.desc: Filesystems, processes, permissions, systemd, and living comfortably in a shell.

modules.title: Git & collaborative workflow
modules.desc: Branching, rebasing, pull requests, and trunk-based development.

modules.title: Networking essentials
modules.desc: DNS, HTTP, TLS, ports, proxies, and load balancing — enough to debug "it can't connect".

modules.title: Scripting with Bash & Python
modules.desc: Automate the repetitive work: files, APIs, JSON/YAML, and exit codes done right.

modules.title: Containers with Docker
modules.desc: Images, layers, multi-stage builds, Compose, and small secure base images.

modules.title: CI/CD pipelines
modules.desc: Build, test, and deploy on every commit with GitHub Actions; caching, matrices, environments.

modules.title: Twelve-Factor applications
modules.desc: Config in the environment, stateless processes, disposability — apps that are easy to operate.

modules.title: Artifacts & supply chain
modules.desc: Registries, versioning, dependency pinning, image scanning, and SBOM basics.

modules.title: Kubernetes core
modules.desc: Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, probes, requests and limits.

modules.title: Packaging with Helm
modules.desc: Charts, values, templating, and releasing the same app to many environments.

modules.title: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
modules.desc: Providers, state, modules, plan/apply discipline, and remote backends.

modules.title: Configuration management with Ansible
modules.desc: Inventories, idempotent playbooks, roles — for everything that isn't a container.

modules.title: GitOps with Argo CD
modules.desc: Git as the source of truth, continuous reconciliation, and drift detection.

modules.title: Cloud fundamentals
modules.desc: Pick one provider and go deep: IAM, networking (VPC), compute, storage, managed databases.

modules.title: Secrets & DevSecOps
modules.desc: Secret managers, least privilege, OIDC instead of long-lived keys, policy as code.

modules.title: Measuring delivery with DORA metrics
modules.desc: Deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore — and how to improve them.

modules.title: Cost awareness (FinOps)
modules.desc: Tagging, right-sizing, autoscaling, and reading a cloud bill before it surprises you.

tracks.tagline: Ship software: Linux, containers, CI/CD, Kubernetes, IaC, cloud.

projects.title: Zero to production: API with CI/CD, Docker, Terraform and dashboards
projects.desc: Start from an empty GitHub repo and finish with a containerised API deployed by a pipeline onto Terraform-managed infrastructure, with logs, metrics and a Grafana dashboard.

projects.title: GitOps on Kubernetes with Argo CD
projects.desc: Local kind cluster, Helm chart, Argo CD syncing from git, Prometheus and Grafana, and a pull-request-driven release flow.

projects.title: Terraform an AWS environment from scratch
projects.desc: VPC, subnets, load balancer, ECS service, RDS and remote state, with plan-on-PR and apply-on-merge in GitHub Actions.

tracks.blurb: Take code from a laptop to production safely and repeatedly: version control, containers, automated pipelines, Kubernetes, and infrastructure defined as code.
tracks.fit: Start here if you're a developer who wants to own deployments, or you're new to infrastructure. It is the foundation the other tracks build on.

tracks.name: Site Reliability Engineering

modules.title: What SRE is (and how it relates to DevOps)
modules.desc: Reliability as a feature, engineering approaches to operations, shared ownership.

modules.title: SLIs, SLOs & error budgets
modules.desc: Choose indicators users actually feel, set targets, and spend the budget deliberately.

modules.title: Eliminating toil
modules.desc: Identify manual, repetitive work and automate it away — and know when not to.

modules.title: Embracing risk
modules.desc: Why 100% is the wrong target, and how to weigh reliability against velocity and cost.

modules.title: Metrics with Prometheus
modules.desc: The four golden signals, PromQL, histograms, recording rules, cardinality pitfalls.

modules.title: Dashboards with Grafana
modules.desc: Dashboards that answer questions during an incident instead of decorating a wall.

modules.title: Traces & logs with OpenTelemetry
modules.desc: Instrument once, export anywhere; context propagation and structured logging.

modules.title: Alerting on symptoms
modules.desc: Multi-window burn-rate alerts, actionable pages, and killing alert fatigue.

modules.title: Sustainable on-call
modules.desc: Rotations, escalation policies, handoffs, and protecting the humans in the loop.

modules.title: Incident response
modules.desc: Incident commander, roles, severity levels, and clear communication under pressure.

modules.title: Blameless postmortems
modules.desc: Timelines, contributing factors, and action items that actually get done.

modules.title: Runbooks & operational readiness
modules.desc: Write the doc you'd want at 3 a.m.; production-readiness reviews before launch.

modules.title: Distributed-systems failure modes
modules.desc: Timeouts, retries with jitter, backpressure, circuit breakers, cascading failure.

modules.title: Capacity planning & load testing
modules.desc: Find the knee of the curve before your users do; forecasting and headroom.

modules.title: Safe releases
modules.desc: Canaries, progressive delivery, feature flags, and automatic rollback.

modules.title: Chaos engineering
modules.desc: Form a hypothesis, inject failure on purpose, limit the blast radius, learn.

tracks.tagline: Keep it reliable: SLOs, observability, incidents, capacity, releases.

projects.title: SLOs from scratch
projects.desc: Instrument a service, scrape it with Prometheus, define SLIs, set an SLO, write burn-rate alerts, build the dashboard and the runbook.

projects.title: Run a full incident drill
projects.desc: Break a service on purpose, page yourself, follow the incident roles, restore, and write the blameless postmortem.

projects.title: Progressive delivery with automated analysis
projects.desc: Weighted canary releases, metrics comparison against baseline, automatic rollback, and a release dashboard.

tracks.blurb: Keep production systems fast, available, and boring. Define reliability with numbers, see what your systems are doing, respond well when they break, and engineer them to break less.
tracks.fit: Start here if you already deploy software and now carry a pager, or you're moving from operations or sysadmin work toward an engineering role.

tracks.name: AI Engineering & AIOps

modules.title: Python for data
modules.desc: NumPy, pandas, notebooks, and plotting — the everyday toolkit.

modules.title: The math you actually need
modules.desc: Vectors, matrices, probability, and gradients — intuition first, proofs optional.

modules.title: Core ML concepts
modules.desc: Supervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, and choosing metrics.

modules.title: Neural networks & deep learning
modules.desc: How networks learn, transformers at a glance, and fine-tuning a pretrained model.

modules.title: How LLMs work
modules.desc: Tokens, context windows, sampling, embeddings — and what that means for your app.

modules.title: Prompt engineering
modules.desc: Clear instructions, examples, structured output, and iterating against test cases.

modules.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
modules.desc: Chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, and grounding answers in your data.

modules.title: Evaluating LLM output
modules.desc: Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites — stop shipping on vibes.

modules.title: Tool use & function calling
modules.desc: Let a model call your APIs: schemas, validation, and the agent loop.

modules.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
modules.desc: The open standard for connecting models to tools and data; build your own server.

modules.title: Agent design & guardrails
modules.desc: Planning, memory, human-in-the-loop approval, prompt-injection defense, least privilege.

modules.title: Cost, latency & caching
modules.desc: Model selection, prompt caching, streaming, batching, and token budgets.

modules.title: Serving models in production
modules.desc: APIs vs. self-hosting, GPUs, autoscaling, and rolling out model changes safely.

modules.title: MLOps pipelines
modules.desc: Versioning data, models, and prompts; reproducible training; CI/CD for ML.

modules.title: LLM observability
modules.desc: Tracing prompts and tool calls, quality and drift monitoring, feedback loops.

modules.title: AIOps: AI for operations
modules.desc: Anomaly detection, alert correlation, and AI-assisted incident triage and root-cause analysis.

tracks.tagline: Make it smarter: LLMs, RAG, agents, evals, MLOps, AIOps.

projects.title: Ship a RAG assistant over your own docs
projects.desc: Index a docs folder, build retrieval plus a grounded prompt, add citations, evals and tracing, and deploy it behind an API.

projects.title: An on-call copilot with tools and guardrails
projects.desc: An agent that reads metrics, logs and runbooks through tools, proposes actions, and never runs anything without approval.

projects.title: Train, register, serve and monitor a model
projects.desc: A small model trained in CI, versioned in a registry, served in a container, with drift and quality monitoring.

projects.title: SkillMatch AI: from semester project to shipped app
projects.desc: Take a Sentence-BERT career recommender from a Streamlit script to a tested, containerised, CI-built app with a public demo, evals and monitoring.

tracks.blurb: Build with AI, not just talk about it: enough machine-learning grounding to reason clearly, then LLM applications, agents and tools, and finally running models in production — including using AI to run production itself.
tracks.fit: Start here if you want to build LLM-powered products or bring AI into operations. Platform engineers: skim Stage 1 and begin at Stage 2.

tracks.name: Cybersecurity
tracks.tagline: Defend it: threat models, identity, hardening, supply chain, detection, response.

modules.title: Threat modelling & the attacker mindset
modules.desc: Assets, attackers, attack surfaces and STRIDE; how to think about what can go wrong before it does.

modules.title: Cryptography in practice
modules.desc: Hashing, symmetric and asymmetric encryption, signatures, TLS and certificates — what to use and what never to hand-roll.

modules.title: Identity & access
modules.desc: Authentication vs authorisation, MFA, sessions and tokens, OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, least privilege.

modules.title: Network security & zero trust
modules.desc: Segmentation, firewalls and security groups, VPNs, DNS and TLS everywhere, why the perimeter is not enough.

modules.title: Linux hardening
modules.desc: Users, sudo, SSH, file permissions, services, auditd and CIS benchmarks for a server you can defend.

modules.title: Secrets management
modules.desc: Where secrets leak, vaults and KMS, short-lived credentials, rotation, and keeping keys out of git.

modules.title: Application security & the OWASP Top 10
modules.desc: Injection, broken access control, SSRF and friends — how each works and the fix that actually holds.

modules.title: Container & Kubernetes security
modules.desc: Image provenance, non-root containers, RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, admission control.

modules.title: Cloud security
modules.desc: IAM done right, public buckets and open security groups, logging, encryption at rest, the shared responsibility model.

modules.title: Software supply chain
modules.desc: Dependencies, SBOMs, signing with Sigstore, SLSA levels and defending the build itself.

modules.title: DevSecOps: security in the pipeline
modules.desc: SAST, DAST, secret scanning, dependency and container scanning, and how to gate without blocking everyone.

modules.title: Security logging, SIEM & detection
modules.desc: What to log, centralising it, writing detections, alert fatigue and the difference between logging and monitoring.

modules.title: Vulnerability management
modules.desc: CVEs, CVSS and EPSS, scanning, prioritising by exploitability, patch SLAs and proving you are actually patched.

modules.title: Security incident response
modules.desc: Preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned — with a real playbook.

modules.title: Compliance for engineers
modules.desc: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and PCI DSS: what auditors ask for and how good engineering satisfies it by default.

modules.title: Capstone: secure a service end to end
modules.desc: Threat-model, harden, scan, monitor and write the incident runbook for a real web service.

projects.title: Secure a web service end to end
projects.desc: Threat model, harden the host and container, scan in CI, manage secrets properly, centralise logs and write detections.

projects.title: Signed and attested builds
projects.desc: SBOM generation, Sigstore signing, provenance attestations and policy enforcement in GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Build a detection lab
projects.desc: Ship auth, system and app logs to a SIEM, write detections for real attacks, and run an incident playbook.

tracks.blurb: Think like an attacker, build like a defender. Threat models, identity, cryptography and hardening first; then securing containers, cloud and the pipeline; then detection, response and the compliance questions engineers actually get asked.
tracks.fit: Start here if you're asked to 'make it secure' and want more than a checklist, or you're moving toward AppSec, cloud security or DevSecOps.

tracks.name: Data Engineering
tracks.tagline: Move and model data: SQL, pipelines, warehouses, streaming, quality, governance.

modules.title: SQL for engineers
modules.desc: Joins, aggregation, window functions, CTEs and reading a query plan — the language everything else speaks.

modules.title: Data modelling
modules.desc: Normalisation, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and choosing a grain.

modules.title: Python for data work
modules.desc: pandas and polars, typed records, files and APIs, idempotent scripts, and when to reach for SQL instead.

modules.title: Storage formats & the lakehouse
modules.desc: Row vs columnar, Parquet, object storage layouts, table formats (Iceberg, Delta) and partitioning.

modules.title: Batch pipeline design
modules.desc: ETL vs ELT, idempotency, backfills, late data, and designing a pipeline you can re-run safely.

modules.title: Orchestration with DAGs
modules.desc: Airflow-style scheduling, dependencies, retries, sensors, backfills and keeping DAGs boring.

modules.title: Transformations with dbt
modules.desc: Models, tests, sources, incremental models, documentation and a warehouse that explains itself.

modules.title: Data quality, tests & contracts
modules.desc: Freshness, volume, schema and distribution checks, data contracts, and stopping bad data at the door.

modules.title: Warehouses at scale
modules.desc: Partitioning, clustering, materialised views, query cost, and the mistakes that make bills explode.

modules.title: Distributed processing with Spark
modules.desc: DataFrames, lazy execution, shuffles, joins, skew, and reading the Spark UI.

modules.title: Streaming with Kafka
modules.desc: Topics, partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees, and stream processing patterns.

modules.title: Change data capture & incremental loads
modules.desc: Log-based CDC, Debezium-style pipelines, merges, snapshots and keeping a replica honest.

modules.title: Data observability & lineage
modules.desc: Pipeline SLAs, freshness monitoring, lineage graphs, and finding which report broke because of which table.

modules.title: Governance, privacy & access
modules.desc: Catalogues, ownership, PII handling, row and column security, retention and the right to be forgotten.

modules.title: Data platform infrastructure
modules.desc: IaC for data, environments, CI/CD for pipelines and models, cost controls and platform boundaries.

modules.title: Capstone: build a lakehouse pipeline
modules.desc: Ingest, model, test, orchestrate and monitor an end-to-end pipeline from raw events to a dashboard.

projects.title: Lakehouse pipeline from raw events to a dashboard
projects.desc: Ingest events to object storage, model with dbt, orchestrate with Airflow, add quality tests and serve a dashboard.

projects.title: Real-time pipeline with Kafka
projects.desc: Produce events, process them in a stream job, land them in a warehouse and watch them arrive on a live dashboard.

projects.title: Data platform with IaC and CI
projects.desc: Terraform the warehouse and buckets, CI for pipelines and dbt models, environments, and cost dashboards.

tracks.blurb: Move data reliably and model it so people can trust it: SQL and modelling first, then batch pipelines and orchestration, then warehouses, Spark and streaming, and finally observability and governance for a platform others depend on.
tracks.fit: Start here if you write SQL and Python and want to own pipelines and platforms, or you're an analyst moving toward engineering.

modules.title: CISSP

projects.title: AWS Solutions Architect lab
projects.desc: Build the reference three-tier architecture the exam keeps describing, then tear it down with Terraform.
